title: COD & Direct Object Pronouns (me, te, le, la, nous, vous, les)

items.word: me, te, le, la, nous, vous, les
items.translation: me, you, him / it, her / it, us, you, them
items.exampleFr: Je le vois. Elle nous invite.
items.exampleEn: I see him. She invites us.
items.hint: me, te, le, la become m', t', l' before a vowel sound

items.translation: Before the conjugated verb, or before the infinitive
items.exampleFr: Je la regarde. Je vais la regarder.
items.exampleEn: I watch it. I am going to watch it.

items.translation: With avoir, the participle agrees with a direct object placed before it

items.prompt: Tu regardes la télé ? — Oui, je ___ regarde.
Vous connaissez Paul ? — Oui, nous ___ connaissons.
Tu aimes les fraises ? — Oui, je ___ adore.
Tu as ton passeport ? — Oui, je ___ ai.
Ce sont mes amis. Je vais ___ appeler demain.

items.explain: In a positive command the pronoun follows the verb, and me becomes moi.

items.prompt: Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Je mange la pomme.”
Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Nous voyons les enfants.”
Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Elle lit le livre.”
Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Je n'aime pas ce film.”
Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Il a vu Marie.”
Replace the noun with a pronoun: “Tu vas acheter le pain.”
Where does the pronoun go in “Je veux voir ce film”?
